title: Grateful Dead Live at St. Paul Civic Center on 1982-08-06
lineage: soundboard master cassette-> cassette-> DAT-> CDR-> .WAV-> SHN

ai_review.summary: High‑quality soundboard recording of an energetic ’82 gig with a smoking Lazy Lightning > Supplication segue and standout Saint Stephen jam.
ai_review.review: The show is praised for its frantic, hyped‑up energy and strong second‑set improvisations, especially the Lazy Lightning > Supplication sequence and the extended Saint Stephen jam. The soundboard source delivers clear, “5‑star” audio quality despite the first three songs being missing from the stream.

ai_rating.rationale: All reviewers rate the performance 4–5 stars and highlight strong musical moments; recording quality is described as excellent to good, yielding a combined high rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Clear and well‑balanced sound noted by reviewers; minor issue that the stream omitted the first three songs.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Second set highlighted for sweet, extended jamming; overall set feels frantic and geared toward a hyped crowd.
